continuationProtocol: 1. Read data/version_log.json internalAudit, WIKI_CONTENT_SCOPE.md and the private Sheets Check tracker; also consult data/wiki_audit_checkpoint.json before proposing changes.

2. Identify latest completed Ver Log changes strictly AFTER last observed source version/date; for already identified unsynced candidates continue from sourceDeltaCandidates. Source versions are not sync versions.
3. Compare only affected source IDs and relevant linked records against existing Wiki JSON; recognize deliberate source-retained/public-hidden or policy-excluded records.
4. Classify each affected record as verified synced, verified missing/changed, source-retained-public-hidden, excluded, pending description/condition/localization, or unfinished.
5. Update the actual category data only after validating fields, localization, conditions, rewards and cross-references. Preserve approved exceptions and IDs.
6. Append a dated detailed entry under entries and update internalAudit category records, deltas, and verified checkpoints. Do not overwrite prior review history.
7. Keep publicStatus/publicSections concise; never display sensitive internal mapping lists or an inflated missing count. Promote full-sync/version markers only after corresponding checks.
